newsitem.title: MEXICO: President Clinton arrives in Mexico for Latam trip.
newsitem.headline: President Clinton arrives in Mexico for Latam trip.

text.p: President Bill Clinton arrived in Mexico on Monday at the start of his first trip to Latin America and the Caribbean.
The U.S. presidential plane Air Force One touched down at Mexico City's Benito Juarez international airport at 6.25 p.m. local time (2325 GMT), the official Mexican news agency Notimex said.

Television pictures showed Clinton dressed in a dark suit moving across the airport apron on crutches to a waiting helicopter which was to whisk him to a military parade ground across the street from his hotel.
Mexican Foreign Minister Jose Angel Gurria greeted Clinton in a very brief ceremony ahead of his official state welcome to Mexico early on Tuesday.

Clinton was to spend two nights in Mexico before travelling on Wednesday evening to San Jose, Costa Rica, for a summit with Central American leaders. The final leg of his trip will take him to Barbados to meet Caribbean presidents before returning to Washington on May 12.
